verses.1: Hear this word: the birds of the forest that live in the mountains of Shmeron, those who are poor and weak, those who cry out to their masters. They bring forth their offspring, and then they die.
verses.2: May the Lord God bless you in His holiness! For days are coming upon you, and He will carry you away in clouds. After that, He will bring you back by a narrow path.
verses.3: And a woman rushed out against her; and the deception was cast upon her. May Jehovah have mercy on her!
verses.4: Go into the Temple and commit your greatest sins. Bring your offerings to the priests on the third day after your sins are forgiven.
verses.5: And let them be freed from the flames of wrath. Let their prayers be heard, for this is what the children of Israel love. May the Lord say so.
verses.6: And I also have given you two signs in every city where you live. There will be no lack of bread in all your places. But do not return to Me, says the LORD.
verses.7: And I too have delayed paying you for three days after the harvest. I’ve also plundered one city after another. I haven’t paid any portion of what I owe. The portion that isn’t yet owed will be taken as spoils.
verses.8: And three cities were separated by water from each other. They could not be united together, and they would never be united again. May the Lord have mercy on them.
verses.9: I have destroyed your vineyards, your olive groves, your gardens, and your fruit trees. They will be eaten by wild animals. Do not return to me again, O LORD!
verses.10: I have sent you words through Egypt. I will kill you in your own land, along with your livestock. I will burn down your tents and your homes. You will not return to me again, says the LORD.
verses.11: I have made you like God in my work. I have transformed Sodom and Gomorrah. They became like ashes that are completely burned away. They will never be restored to their former state, says the LORD.
verses.12: Therefore, I will do this to you, Israel, because this is what I will do to you. I will make it known to you, Israel, that you are God’s people.
verses.13: For behold, He creates mountains and breaths life into them. He also tells man what he should eat; He makes clothes for him to wear, and He guides him along the paths of the earth. The Lord is the God of hosts.
